rationale: Manual human promotion decision (no automated run_benchmark/decide_promotion was used -- that mechanism scores a single legacy overall_label.grade and does not apply to the four-dimension per-dimension ordinal scheme; see run_four_dim_training.py module docstring). A2 (deberta_v3_base_four_dim_training_v3_expA2_epoch7, best epoch 7) was selected as the final four-dimension evaluator after the completed A0 (unweighted) -> A1 (raw pos_weight) -> A2 (smoothed pos_weight, alpha=0.4) loss-weighting ablation and the B0 (private per-dimension MLP) architecture ablation, evaluated against the frozen 58-example V4 diagnostic benchmark. Reported A2 metrics: val mean QWK 0.6372, test mean QWK 0.4783 (TC 0.2270, depth 0.8920, relevance 0.2890, grounding 0.5050) on the frozen four_dim_experiment_v2 166/27/27 split. On V4: 7/20 pair groups correctly separated, 0 incorrectly ordered (vs A0 2/20 correct 1 incorrect, A1 6/20 correct 2 incorrect); relevance-alignment pair separation 3/8 with 0 incorrect (vs A0 0/8, A1 3/8 with 1 incorrect); multipart relevance QWK 0.7619 (vs A0 0.3359, A1 0.6379). A2 was the strongest overall candidate across these completed experiments -- approved for production deployment.
